The Feeding Station in the Nursery. Puts a clean assembled bottle or a full set of pump parts into your hands at 2 a.m. without a single decision.

What done looks like:
1. One bin of clean bottles assembled with teats
2. A second bin of used parts waiting
3. A drying rack standing empty
4. The formula scoop inside the tin with the lid shut
